"Ah, they ran away!
Get back heeere! Hey, you!!"{w}

"Say, Mirco.
Are you really sure it's this way?"{w}

"How should I know?!
Hey, Hess. Use your magic to show us the map again."{w}

"You may ask all you like,
but I've no magic power left, I'm afraid."{w}

"Then let's have tea and take a breather.
Drinking tea gets your magic back, right?"{w}
"...Gurtia, do you mean to torture me with tea?"{w}

"My feet hurt! My armor's heavy!
I'm tired! I hate this!"{w}

"That is quite enough!
And you call yourself a member of the proud House Lenzer?!"{w}
"That does it! This time, I won't let you off!"{w}

"Grwaaah!
Knock that little shit's attitude into shape!{w}...No, knock it till it snaps!!"{w}

"My, my.
You seem to be having fun, young master."{w}

"Please... wait...
I-I'm still... drinking my third cup...{w}Urp!"{w}

"Ha ha ha! Not good enough, Master Mirco!!
Did you really think you could get away from Zephal?!{w}...Hm? And who might these people be?"{w}

"I kind of bumped into them...
Um, are you all right?"{w}
"It appears they are people of this land."{w}

"Enemies?! Elpina, did you spot something?{w}...Ooh, first prey we've seen in ages!
Let's kill 'em quick and chow down!!"{w}

"Gurtia, Zapper! What is all this?!
Honestly, such a racket.{w}We are not here to play, so do behave a little..."{w}
"Look, Hess!{w}It's Master Mirco's first battle! Let's cheer him on!"{w}
"Never mind, never mind. Off you go now.{w}We'll be watching over you from right here!"{w}
"Huh? Just me?{w}Aren't you all going to fight with me?"{w}
"Go on, go on! All... by... your... self!"{w}

"Come now, young master, show Gurtia here
how brave you are!"{w}

(And then he'll get stomped on and beaten black and blue,
and come crying to me for help, sobbing his eyes out!{w}Ahh, I can't wait... Hee hee hee hee!!){w}
"Yikes, Sis! Your eyes look sooo dangerous~!"{w}

"But I'm the leader...
Somehow... doesn't this seem kinda unfair???"{w}

"Whatever do you mean, young master?{w}Everyone is doing this precisely because
they want you to grow."{w}

"Of course.{w}Besides, you look wonderful when you're
trying your best!"{w}
"Nice one, Sis.{w}You actually got Mirco of all people fired up!"{w}

"Okay, I'll go beat them!
Gurtia, watch me!!"{w}

"Yes! I'll be watching closely!
Off you go, now!"{w}

"For your first battle,
allow me, Zephal, to offer you some advice."{w}{p}"Young master, you lack speed, strength, wits,
skill and guts. You must devise tactics that
cover for those shortcomings."{w}

"Cover...?
Um... so what ARE my strong points?"{w}
"If you have any, I'm the one who'd like to know!"{w}

"Young master!
Your strong point is being cute!"{w}

"Uh-huh.{w}Like how happy-go-lucky you are -- you're
such fun to mess with!"{w}
"Youuu little-- Quit playing dumb!{w}If you come back a loser, you'll answer to me!!"{w}

"I won't lose!{w}I've got the demon sword Baltagias
that my uncle gave me!"{w}

"Here I come!
I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!!"{w}
"Oh my, young master~ You look positively battered!"{w}
"What kind of stance was that?!{w}Didn't I teach you that's not how you hold a sword?!"{w}{p}"And you don't step in hard enough!{w}Your hips should be more like this! Like THIS!!"{w}
"Everyone, you're going too far.{w}Please don't pick on the young master so much."{w}

"Oh, that's right!
Sorry, Mirco, you half-baked little greenhorn."{w}
"Heyyy!!!{w}I tried my best too, you know?!"{w}
"Yes. What a splendid defeat it was!"{w}

"Mean. You're all so mean...{w}Hess...
Am I really that hopeless?"{w}

"Eh?! Well, that's... um...{w}R-right, the young master is, er, one of those...
a late bloomer, wouldn't you say?!"{w}
"'Wouldn't you say'? Who are you asking to agree?"{w}
"First things first, young master...{w}let's cure your bed-wetting. Everything starts there."{w}

"What, bed-wetting?!{w}Young master, don't tell me you still wet the bed?!
You did?! Surely not, at your age?!"{w}
"Oh, I'm so sorry. It just slipped out!"{w}

"It stiiinks!
I can smell it all the way over here!!"{w}

"The young master washing his own soiled things
was so miserable and so lovely~! Hee hee hee!!"{w}

"Pardon me. I apologize for hitting you.
But still, how pathetic..."{w}
"Surely it was just a fluke.{w}The young master is no child, after all."{w}
"Actually, this morning made three days in a row!"{w}
"Th-that does it! I am the Hell Master!!"{w}

"Not content with once or twice...
THREE TIMES?!!"{w}
"Pardon me. I apologize for hitting you."{w}
"Y-yoo... yoo're nod sowwy ad all, are yoo"{w}
"Sigh... This is beyond pathetic!{w}At this rate, how can I ever face the master..."{w}
"Now then, young master, let's treat your wounds.{w}Here's some salve. Hold still for me~"{w}
"It's medicine, after all. It can't be helped.{w}See, it hurts. There! And therrre~!"{w}
"Ow, I said it hurts! You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?!"{w}

"W-well, I'll let you off with this for today!
Next time, I'll beat you for sure!"{w}

"Urk..."{w}{p}"I-if you bully me,
my uncle won't stand for it!{w}My uncle is a Demon Duke, you know!"{w}
By the look of him, child or not, he is high-born: a Kin of Darkness... no, a noble of darkness.{w}It might be wise not to push him too far.{w}
"Eeeeek, these people are serious!?{w}Wh-wh-what do I do!?"{w}{p}"Help...{w}Help me, Uncle!!"{w}
"It has been far too long, my liege!"{w}
"Mirco.{w}You are the one who will someday inherit our House Lenzer.{w}How can you go on in such a disgraceful state?"{w}

"Hmph. Well, no matter.{w}...So it was you who dragged the name of my house through the mud."{w}{p}"I am loath to barge into a children's quarrel like some parent...{w}but I cannot simply let you go home."{w}{p}"Regrettably, you must die.{w}There is no need to lament.
In time, we shall hold all things in our grasp."{w}{p}"Even if you lived a little longer...{w}{p}{0E}"Even if you lived a little longer... {0F}it would change nothing."{w}
"To think the master himself would appear..."{w}

"Ahh... to think I could behold my liege
with my own eyes in such a backwater...{w}I shall sleep well tonight!!"{w}
"Now then, let us be going as well.{w}There is no reason to linger in a place like this."{w}
"How many times do I gotta tell ya the same thing!!{w}Don't close your eyes when the enemy attacks!!"{w}

"You will never defeat an enemy
just by squawking and wailing!!"{w}

"Damn you, Mirco!
Changin' up your scream ain't gonna cut it!!"{w}
"Not even a hint of progress, is there?"{w}
"Perhaps the young master is better suited to his studies, hm..."{w}

"It's not about which one he's good at,
it's about which one he's less hopeless at, right?"{w}

"You think 'stop' works on a battlefield!?
Zapper, attack more sharply!!{w}Master Mirco's weak point is his footing!!"{w}

"Oh, what are you doing, Zapper?
You're letting him slip away...{w}There, right there... Get him!!"{w}

"GRAAAAAAH!{w}Mirco, you little punk,
you still haven't swung your sword even once!!"{w}

"Hey, hey, who do you think'll snap first,
Zephal or Zapper?{w}My money's on Zapper!"{w}
"Then just wait a second, will you!{w}Give me time to raise my sword!!"{w}

"Zephal, I'd say.{w}Any moment now he'll shout 'I am the Hell Master!'
and beat the stuffing out of Master Mirco."{w}
"Honestly, you two.{w}Zephal and Zapper have both honed their mental discipline.{w}Unless it's something really bad, they won't snap during practice."{w}

"Knock it off already!!
I am the Hell Masterrrr!!"{w}
"Ooh, you called it, Sis!{w}Mirco really must be that bad, huh!"{w}
"...Hey, hold up, Zephal!{w}Don't you sense somethin'?"{w}

"Indeed.
This is... that lot from before.{w}Show yourselves!!"{w}
"So what'll it be? Send Mirco in again?"{w}

"I would like to, but any more disgrace
would tarnish the name of House Lenzer as well."{w}{p}"I think the two of us should join in this time."{w}

"Right!
I've been itchin' to cut loose myself."{w}
"Ha ha, now this is getting fun!"{w}
"But you were cutting loose just a minute ago."{w}

"You ain't even enough for a warm-up,
you worthless scuuuuum!!"{w}
You routed Mirco and the others.{w}
"The swords you can pick up in this land are all junk, huh.{w}Want me to go grab you another one?"{w}

"No, that's quite all right."{w}{p}"At this point, I'll return to Belnaf
and fetch my usual sword.{w}This is getting us nowhere."{w}

"What am I supposed to do if a strong enemy
shows up while you're gone, Zephal!?"{w}
"You have Zapper, don't you?{w}And besides, if it really comes to that...{w}couldn't you just defeat it yourself, Master Mirco?"{w}

"Master Mirco, you cannot keep
leaning on me forever.{w}What do you think that Baltagias is for?"{w}
"Master Mirco.{w}Swear on that Baltagias of yours."{w}

"That next time, you will win, no matter what.{w}That even without me, you will be victorious!"{w}{p}"We can't have you forever dragging the name of House Lenzer, the name of Lord Dalisiamarte...{w}through the mud, can we?"{w}
"Yes. If you stay as you are now."{w}
"Wait! I don't mean to do anything like that!{w}I want to be useful to Uncle too, you know!"{w}

"But does merely wanting it change anything?"{w}{p}"'I want to be stronger.'{w}'I want to be wiser.'{w}'I want to build my willpower.'"{w}{p}"Everyone wants those things.{w}But most people can never turn those wishes into goals!"{w}{p}"They talk about their ideals, feel as if they've already achieved them, and then just wait for somebody else to fix everything.{w}...Just like you, right now!"{w}
"Right now, you have nothing."{w}{p}"You're weak, you're stupid, you're slow,{w}a runty little crybaby who wets his pants.{w}...Ah, dammit! Now I'm getting angry all over again!!"{w}
"But you have a future.{w}You can still grow a great deal."{w}

"It is by your own strength that you change yourself, and the world.{w}Only one who can turn wishes into goals and take that step can become a true lord."{w}{p}"...Your uncle is just that sort of man.{w}Stand on your own two feet, Master Mirco.{w}No -- heir to the house. Lord Mirco Lenzer."{w}
"But... you can tell me that all you want!{w}I can't do anything..."{w}
"...I will be taking my leave now."{w}{p}"You there. That was a splendid attack, but the next time we meet, I will fight you in earnest.{w}Be ready for it."{w}
"They're back!?{w}Dammit, and Zephal's not even here!"{w}{p}"Wh-what do I do...?{w}Hey, you'll all lend me a hand this time, won't you?"{w}
"Obviously!{w}No way you could win on your own!!"{w}
"Fear not. This time, I shall join the fight as well..."{w}
"Oh, fine. Guess I'll pitch in for you!"{w}
"If we all work together, we're bound to win!{w}Dragging Uncle's name through the mud...{w}I never, ever want to do that!"{w}
You routed Mirco and the others.{w}
"Why... why can't I win...?{w}We were so close...!!"{w}{p}"I fought just the way Zephal and Zapper told me to... so why!!"{w}
"That is because, in your heart, you are still losing, Master Mirco."{w}
"I was watching that battle just now."{w}
"Why can't I win!?{w}I gave that fight everything I had!!"{w}
"Yes. Well, it was not perfect, but it was the most aggressive fight you have ever put up.{w}Let me see... I would call it your first passing grade."{w}

"Master Mirco... you are still counting on everyone else's strength, after all."{w}{p}"Zapper for muscle, Hess for spells, Gurtia and Elpina for support."{w}{p}"'Even if I mess up, everyone will take care of it.'{w}Isn't that what you think?"{w}

"Master Mirco, you are the leader of this party.{w}You hold the fate of all five of us in your hands."{w}{p}"Even if you stand alone, you must have the resolve to fight with our lives and your own on your shoulders -- the resolve of a lord."{w}
"You told me once you thought the boss was cool, didn't ya?"{w}

"Bet that's the real secret behind him bein' so cool, too."{w}{p}"That man... no matter how strong the enemy... yeah, even if it was a god,"{w}{p}"if it means protectin' us and Belnaf, he's got the resolve to fight without a thought for himself. That's the kind of man he is."{w}{p}"It's a different kind of resolve, but Hilde's got it...{w}and, well, I guess even Zoze does."{w}
"So that's what it was...{w}That's why Uncle is so cool."{w}{p}"...Zephal. Not just getting stronger -- do you think I can have resolve like Uncle's someday?"{w}
"Indeed.{w}That is exactly why the five of us are here: to help you find it, Master Mirco."{w}{p}"To offer a hand to anyone who tries to stand.{w}That is the way of the knight."{w}
"Whoa, so I'm counted in too?{w}I just tagged along with Sis."{w}
"Having come this far together, we're all in the same boat now, surely."{w}
"Oh, that reminds me.{w}Sis, how come you didn't fight alongside him back there?"{w}
"Well, duh. Who'd feel like helpin' a master who leans on everybody else for everything? Right, Gurtia?"{w}
"Oh, I get it. Ahaha, that makes sense.{w}I'm sorry about everything till now, Gurtia."{w}{p}"I'm gonna get way, way stronger, and protect you and everyone else, Gurtia!"{w}
"Y-yes. I am... looking forward to it."{w}
"Now then, I have fetched my sword as well. With this, I can finally face you in earnest."{w}
"I'm gonna get way, way stronger! Next time I'll win for sure!"{w}
From somewhere far off, you heard the voices of Hess and Gurtia.{w}
"They've each gone off to play or to rest."{w}
"I see...{w}Say, Gurtia, won't you have a talk with me? It has been a long while."{w}
"Oh, Hess, honestly.{w}Why, we talk all the time."{w}
"There are things one can only speak of at a time like this."{w}
"How long has it been now, since you became the wet nurse?"{w}
"...I learned a servant's duties from the previous head of the house, and was placed with Master Mirco right after, so..."{w}
"I see. About as long as the young master has been alive, then. Mm, so it was."{w}
"You still resent them, don't you?{w}House Lenzer... Lord Dalisiamarte."{w}
"Who can say. Whatever could you mean?"{w}

"When we set out on this training journey, I was checking the backgrounds of those coming along, and I happened to find out."{w}{p}"How you came to serve our house.{w}All because you had such a rare, healthy body..."{w}

"That is all in the past. Would you kindly drop the subject?"{w}{p}"It isn't as if anything was done to me. And without lifting a finger, I earned the shining distinction of being wet nurse to the future Demon Duke."{w}
"...Have you given up singing and playing your instrument, then? I have never heard you sing, you see."{w}
"Lullabies, yes -- many times, for Master Mirco."{w}
"Your singing voice was so remarkably beautiful, I always did wonder about it."{w}
"...Hess. Forgive me, but I fail to see the point of this conversation."{w}
"It's true that I was made a wet nurse against my will, by a force I could not resist: the wishes of House Lenzer."{w}{p}"But what good does it do to look back on it like this now?"{w}
"...Seeing you hold back from fighting alongside Master Mirco, I thought... well... that perhaps you still bear some grudge..."{w}

"Oh, so that's what this is about. In that case, why not simply order me again? 'Fight alongside Master Mirco,' you could say."{w}{p}"I am only a lowly, insignificant demon. I could hardly defy a Demon Duke."{w}
"No, that's not it -- that's not it at all, Gurtia!"{w}{p}"...I want you to forgive him. The master... Or at the very least, Master Mirco."{w}
"Hah! Is that all!!{w}Then, as I said, why not simply order me to?"{w}
"Haaaah..."{w}{p}"You steal a person's future, and then ask them to like you."{w}{p}"My, my, one convenient demand after another! Just what I'd expect from the Demon Duke's House Lenzer!"{w}
"Isn't it about time to eat?{w}Zephal and Zapper trained me again, and after all that running around, I'm starving!"{w}{p}"Look at these blisters. Here too!"{w}
"Master Mirco did quite well today. His attack still needs a lot of work, but his defense is really taking shape."{w}
"I couldn't say. She's probably gone off hunting for junk again..."{w}
"Y-you've been up there all this time?!"{w}
"Yep. I was just napping up top. Didn't you notice?"{w}
"Mmm... well, yeah.{w}More importantly, is this okay? There's a bunch of people who've been peeking at us from over there for a while now."{w}
"You showed up at just the right time. Hey, Mirco! Show 'em what all that training got you!"{w}
"I shall wash away our last defeat with your blood!"{w}
"...So, Sis, what are you gonna do? Just watch again today?"{w}
"Hate to admit it, but these guys are the kind we can't beat unless we go all out.{w}Mind lendin' us a hand?"{w}
"Yes, please. With you here, our fighting strength would surely be on solid footing."{w}
"I'm asking you too.{w}When you're by my side, Gurtia, I can fight without getting nervous."{w}
"Of course I do! ...W-why are you asking all of a sudden?"{w}
"You heard him, Sis! Good for you~"{w}
"Sis. Mirco is Mirco, you know?{w}Sure, I was only listening in, but even so... that story makes me sick to my stomach."{w}
"I'm sure you've got feelings you can't take out on anyone.{w}But... you don't actually mind being his wet nurse all that much, do you?"{w}
"When you're mending Mirco's clothes, or making those chocolate cornets he loves, Sis, you look like you're having a really great time~"{w}
"What have you two been talking about this whole time?"{w}
"See, see? You're confusing poor Mirco, Sis."{w}
"Hehe. If you need to vent, I'll listen as long as it takes!"{w}
"Oh, that's right, Hess.{w}There is one thing I should tell you, so there is no misunderstanding.{w}A word in your ear..."{w}

(When I see something cute... I just can't help wanting to torment it and watch it squirm.){w}{p}(I do not think well of the House. However...{w}where Master Mirco is concerned, my own personal tastes come into it as well...){w}{p}(So please do not let it trouble you too much.{w}...Hee hee hee!!){w}
"Now then, let us clear away this unsightly trash quickly, shall we, young master?"{w}
"Thanks, Gurtia!{w}All right, this time we're gonna beat 'em to a pulp!!"{w}
You routed Mirco and the others.{w}
"N-not even all of us together can win...?"{w}

"Tch.
We've got ourselves one hell of a rival."{w}
"But it was the first time we all fought together!"{w}
"Indeed!{w}This sense of unity reminds me of my days in the knightly order!!"{w}
"You guys are really strong.{w}We lost again this time, but let's have a rematch someday! Next time, we'll win!"{w}
"We meet again!{w}You know, I've actually started looking forward to fighting you guys."{w}
"Just like you've been growing, I've gotten stronger too! Now, have at you!!"{w}
You routed Mirco and the others.{w}

"Ow ow ow...
I guess I really can't beat you that easily..."{w}
"But I'm not giving up! Someday I'll overtake you, I swear!{w}Until then, don't you dare lose to anyone!"{w}
"Hmm... where on earth are we?!{w}And that lot is here as well."{w}
"Feels kinda weird. Like I've got my five senses, but also like I don't..."{w}
"I get it, this has gotta be a dream!"{w}
"Whoa...{w}Oh, I know!{w}If this is a dream, maybe we can win!"{w}
"Why not?{w}We can't avoid a fight either way, I'd imagine."{w}
You routed Mirco and the others.{w}
"We lost again...{w}But it's fine if it's a dream, right?"{w}
"Then I'm the Hell Master, dream or not!!"{w}
"Dreaming that I'm in a dream with everyone...{w}How curious."{w}
"Not to sound like Mirco, but is this one of those deals where we wake up and it's like none of it ever happened?"{w}
"So we won't remember any of it either?"{w}
"I see, it won't stay in anyone's memory.{w}I seeee.{w}...Heh heh heh!"{w}
"Ha ha ha, is that so! Nobody will remember!{w}Then it's fine for me to cut loose, isn't it!?"{w}
"Heh... heh heh heh..."{w}{p}"Fwahahaha! Then let us march to battllllle!{w}Follow me, follow meeeeee, you hear!{w}Smash it allllll! Woo-hoooooo!!"{w}
Zephal ran off, swinging his sword around.{w}

"Hey, Mircooo...{w}Hurry up and get strong,
and ride on my back, okay?"{w}
"'Cause I'm waitin' for ya.{w}My reins are there just for you, y'know?{w}You get that part, riiight?"{w}

"I get it...
I mean, snuggling up to me like this..."{w}

"Then train harder, c'mooon~"{w}{p}"Or else yours truly might go and become
somebody else's griffon, y'know?{w}Is that okay? Is it, huh?"{w}

"T-too close, you're too close...
Hey! Zapper!?"{w}
The two of them ran off.{w}

"What a strange place this is. Well then, perhaps I too...
shall go looking for a spring that's come a little late, eh!?{w}Ho ho ho!!"{w}

"Huff, huff, huff...
I finally got away!!{w}Gurtia, are you okay?"{w}
"Y-yes.{w}I'm fine, and yet somehow not fine...{w}I see you made it through unharmed, young master."{w}

"Honestly, everyone's doing whatever they want
just because it's a dream."{w}{p}"I noticed while I was running,
these clothes seem to have gotten
a little small on me."{w}
"Oh, so they have. You're a growing boy, after all."{w}

"Will you make me new clothes again?{w}I could have some sent from home,
but I'd rather have clothes you sewed for me, Gurtia."{w}
"This time, so they'll hold up even when I move around a lot..."{w}
"Something sturdy and easy to move in..."{w}
(And whatever I do, nobody will remember it once they wake up...){w}
"Master Mirco, I wish you'd just die."{w}

"I hope House Lenzer loses its heir
and falls to ruin!!"{w}
Gurtia pinched Mirco's cheeks with both hands!{w}

(What a pathetic noise to make!
For a brat like this, I...!!){w}
(Even so, I'm the one who raised him, aren't I... this child...){w}
Gurtia picked Mirco up in her arms.{w}

"P-put me down, this is embarrassing!{w}Pinching me, picking me up...
have you gone weird too, Gurtia!?"{w}
"...Weird?{w}Yes, I suppose. Perhaps I have.{w}Hee hee hee!"{w}
"For a little while...{w}um, would you walk with me, just the two of us?{w}Shall we explore? This place, I mean. ...Won't you?"{w}
"J-just so you know!{w}Geez. I'm not a kid, okay!?"{w}
"My apologies.{w}Hee hee. Please don't be cross."{w}
But you are floating in midair{w}

Your bodies would no longer obey you,
and you were dragged off somewhere!!{w}
Where's my ball... Where's my baaall...{w}
"Fooound youuu!{w}My cute little baaalls!!{w}C'mon, c'mon! Let's play some golf, huh!?"{w}{p}"Kyeeehhh!!"{w}
The clown doll raised the club high!{w}
